description: V1-46b-TOKEN-PAY-COMPLETE with V1-46-PUB-PAY-LINK-TOKEN-GATE (M34; D-07, 2026-10-31: token links only). Run from apps/server against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL: npx vitest run test/pay-link-token-gate.integration.test.ts test/revenue-authorization.integration.test.ts src/core/auth/public-surface.spec.ts --no-file-parallelism --reporter=json --outputFile=<report>, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/pay-link-token-gate.json --report <report>. Required: every pay-link-token-gate case (the token pay read, intent, status, gateway list, per-provider checkout and PayPal capture keyed by the pay-link token; a revoked, expired, inactive, unknown or foreign-tenant link refused on every one with one 404 and no provider called; the token read carries no invoice id; the anonymous bare-id read, status, gateway list and generic checkout closed once every link of the invoice is revoked or expired, the operator routes unchanged; the bare-id per-provider checkouts and capture retired; widgets/pay/[invoiceId] retired; no source emits a bare /pay/<invoiceId> URL and every producer emits /public/invoice/<token>; Stripe, PayPal and WiPay callbacks still record money for a revoked link, providers stubbed, no network), RA-V46B-01 (the revenue-authorization pin of the closing bare-id branch) and the two public-surface ledger cases (payments.controller.ts and commerce.controller.ts stay at 11 open handlers). allowAdditionalCases is true for the rest of revenue-authorization (bound by payments-actor.json and public-payment-intent.json) and the it.todo TG-22: the WiPay callback hash is md5 of public values with no secret, and the PayPal capture records invoice.total and posts nothing to the ledger (M35, V1-05; outside this packet). Review repairs: the automated producers (overdue, due-soon and payment-failed emails, KEY invoice_sent, autopilot recovery) never mint a link for an invoice whose links were all revoked or expired (CommerceService.automatedInvoiceUrl; an anonymous WiPay failure callback cannot reopen it, TG-18h/TG-18i); the token PayPal capture reads the order first and captures only one made for the token's invoice and its total (TG-14d); the WiPay checkout is documented as the one token answer that carries the invoice id, as WiPay's order_id (TG-16b). SCOPE LIMIT: an invoice that never had a pay link keeps the KF-REVENUE-AUTH-PROJECTION-001 bare-id answer (release0-journey step 6 pins it); this manifest does not prove that case closed.
requiredCases: fixture sanity (real rows) two tenants; links minted, paid and revoked through the operator routes; the unknown-token answers are 404 on the token routes

the pay page is keyed by the token (V1-46) TG-01: a live link answers the pay-page projection: the bare-id public read's anonymous answer less the invoice id; no payment rows, bank details or customer email

the pay page is keyed by the token (V1-46) TG-02: the projection states what has been paid and what remains (40 of 100), and a settled invoice stays readable through its link as PAID with nothing remaining

the pay page is keyed by the token (V1-46) TG-03: a payment intent through a live link answers the R0-22 success, writes one PENDING row on the invoice's own tenant, leaves the status and the ledger as they were, and the link still reads
the pay page is keyed by the token (V1-46) TG-04: an intent through the live link of a settled invoice is the R0-22 409; nothing written

a revoked link stops every customer action (M34) TG-05: deactivating the link through the operator route turns a working pay page and intent into the unknown-token 404 on every action; nothing is written after the revocation
a revoked link stops every customer action (M34) TG-06: an expired, an inactive, an unknown and a foreign-tenant link answer one 404 on every action; nothing written
a revoked link stops every customer action (M34) TG-07: a DRAFT, a VOID and a soft-deleted invoice behind a live link answer the unknown-token 404 on the pay page and the intent; nothing written
a revoked link stops every customer action (M34) TG-08 LEDGER: no payment or posting is reachable through a revoked token: Payment rows, computeBalance and both ledger counts are unchanged
the bare-id pay actions are retired (D-07) TG-09: POST /commerce/invoices/:invoiceId/payment-intent is gone: a SENT invoice whose only link is revoked answers 404 and nothing is written
the bare-id pay actions are retired (D-07) TG-10: GET /commerce/payment-links/:token, the resolver that handed out the invoice id for the /pay/:invoiceId downgrade, is gone: 404 with no invoice id
the bare-id pay actions are retired (D-07) TG-11: the bare-id public read keeps its redacted projection (KF-REVENUE-AUTH-PROJECTION-001): 200 for a SENT invoice, 404 for a DRAFT one
TENANT and the route contract (V1-46) TG-12 TENANT: tenant B's live token reads and writes tenant B's invoice only; tenant A's invoices, payments and links are byte-identical
TENANT and the route contract (V1-46) TG-13: both token routes sit behind PublicRateLimitGuard alone (the token is the credential); the pay page allows 30 reads a minute and the intent 10 writes

the payment routes are keyed by the token (V1-46b) TG-14: through a live link the status (five keys), the gateway list and a checkout per provider (Stripe, WiPay, PayPal; stubbed, no network) answer, and each provider request names the token's invoice; nothing is recorded by a checkout

the payment routes are keyed by the token (V1-46b) TG-14b: the PayPal capture through a live link records one SUCCESSFUL row against the token's invoice; an invoiceId in the body naming another invoice is ignored

the payment routes are keyed by the token (V1-46b) TG-14d (review SEC-V46B-3): the token capture captures only an order made for the token's invoice and its total: another invoice's, another tenant's, a wrong-amount and an unknown order are refused (400) before PayPal captures anything, and nothing is written

the payment routes are keyed by the token (V1-46b) TG-14c: the route contract: the four token payment routes sit behind the class-level PublicRateLimitGuard alone with their limits; the bare-id per-provider checkouts and the bare-id PayPal capture are gone from payments.controller.ts

revocation holds on the bare-id routes (V1-46b, ST-1) TG-15 (ST-1): after the only link is revoked or has expired, an anonymous caller holding the invoice id gets the unknown-id 404 from GET /commerce/invoices/:id, GET /payments/invoice/:id/status and /gateways and POST /payments/create-checkout; the bare per-provider checkouts and capture are gone; nothing is written and no provider is called

revocation holds on the bare-id routes (V1-46b, ST-1) TG-15b: the operator routes are unchanged for that invoice: the owner reads the full shape on GET /commerce/invoices/:id and on the tenant-bound detail route

revocation holds on the bare-id routes (V1-46b, ST-1) TG-15c: an invoice with a live link, and one that never had a link, keep the bare-id projection (KF-REVENUE-AUTH-PROJECTION-001; release0-journey step 6 pins the never-linked case)

revocation holds on the bare-id routes (V1-46b, ST-1) TG-16 (ST-1): the token pay read no longer returns the invoice id, and the status, gateway list, Stripe and PayPal checkouts do not answer it (the WiPay checkout carries it as WiPay's order_id: TG-16b)

revocation holds on the bare-id routes (V1-46b, ST-1) TG-16b (review SEC-V46B-4): the WiPay checkout is the one token answer that carries the invoice id, as WiPay's order_id (its hosted page and callback are keyed by it); once the link is revoked, that id opens no bare-id route and no token route

the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-17 (ST-2): widgets/pay/[invoiceId] is retired: it reads and writes nothing and shows the 'no longer used' state of /pay/[invoiceId]; the attendee row links the token link

the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-18a (CR-01): no source file emits a bare /pay/<invoiceId> or /widgets/pay/<invoiceId> URL, and the pay page and client.ts call only token-keyed payment routes
the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-18b (CR-01): the overdue reminder (flow.listener) emails /public/invoice/<token>, creating the link when the invoice has none
the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-18c (CR-01): KEY's invoice_sent (flow-orchestrator) emails /public/invoice/<token> and reuses the invoice's live link
the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-18d (CR-01): autopilot payment recovery (delegation-loop) emails /public/invoice/<token>
the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-18e: the due-soon reminder (flow.listener), which linked the non-existent /invoices/<id>, emails /public/invoice/<token>

the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-18g: the payment-failed email's retry link (flow.listener), which pointed at the non-existent /invoices/<id>/pay, is /public/invoice/<token>
the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-18f: the shared helper gives a settled invoice its existing link (findAnyPaymentLink, as resend-receipt does), never a bare-id URL

the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-18h (review SEC-V46B-2, CR-V46B-01): no automated producer reopens an invoice whose links were all revoked or expired: the overdue, due-soon, payment-failed, autopilot and KEY emails go without a pay link, no link is minted, and the bare-id routes stay closed

the widget pay page and the producers (V1-46b, ST-2, CR-01) TG-18i (review SEC-V46B-1; V1-05 CR-V05-3): an anonymous, unsigned WiPay failure callback for an invoice whose link was revoked mints no link and mails nothing: it is answered { success: false } and emits no payment-failed event (real WiPayConnector and event bus), and the bare-id routes stay closed

provider webhooks and callbacks keep working (V1-46b) TG-19: a signed Stripe checkout.session.completed webhook records the payment for an invoice whose link has been revoked (keyed by the signed event; no network)

provider webhooks and callbacks keep working (V1-46b) TG-20: a verified PayPal PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED webhook records the capture for an invoice whose link has been revoked (verification stubbed; no network)
provider webhooks and callbacks keep working (V1-46b) TG-21: a WiPay success callback records the payment for an invoice whose link has been revoked

V1-46b: the anonymous bare-id branch closes behind revoked links (D-07) RA-V46B-01: an invoice whose only link was deactivated, or whose links have all expired, answers the unknown-id 404 on the public view, the status poll and the gateway list; the owner still reads the full shape
the unauthenticated HTTP surface no controller exposes an unauthenticated handler that is not acknowledged
the unauthenticated HTTP surface the ledger shrinks and does not go stale
